APPROVE
`Files` drops to roughly 7 because the listing, per-file reading and link-checking moved into helpers, which keep the same control flow (the `maxFiles` break still exits only the entry loop, so subdirectories are still queued), the same exception filters and the same `Unread` entries, and the widened `CHA0004` pragma now covers the helpers' catches so the build stays warning-free.
